info.title: Callora API
info.description: API contract covering Callora backend billing, usage, and developer routes.

post.description: Adds prepaid USDC credits to a user account for the GrantFox FWC26 campaign. Requires admin authentication and the admin IP allowlist.

get.summary: Get gateway health for an API
get.description: Returns aggregated upstream latency percentiles and circuit breaker state for a given API slug. Public endpoint — no authentication required. Only aggregated metrics are returned; no tenant identifiers or raw histogram data are exposed. Results are cached in-memory for 5 seconds.

post.summary: Deduct billing balance for up to 100 API calls in one batch
post.description: Creates usage events for up to 100 billing entries in a single database transaction, then performs one aggregate on-chain deduction for the newly inserted entries. Existing requestIds are treated idempotently and are returned in the per-entry results without being charged again.

get.description: Returns the authenticated developer's most-called API endpoints ranked by call volume within the requested time window. Useful for identifying hot endpoints and optimising spend. Defaults to the last 30 days and top 5 endpoints when the corresponding query parameters are omitted.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of period (ISO-8601). Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of period (ISO-8601). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of endpoints to return. Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 5.

parameters.name: apiId
parameters.description: Filter results to a specific API by its ID.

data.description: Endpoints ordered by call count descending. Ties are broken by endpoint path ascending.

calls.description: Total number of calls to this endpoint in the period.

revenue.description: Total revenue generated in smallest USDC units (string to avoid precision loss).

to.description: Effective end of the query period.

get.description: Returns per-API daily usage anomalies for admin review. Usage events are aggregated to per-API daily call counts over the requested window, then each API's days are scored against that API's own baseline using a z-score test; days whose absolute z-score meets the threshold are flagged as spikes or drops. Requires admin authentication and the admin IP allowlist.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of analysis window (ISO-8601). Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of analysis window (ISO-8601). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Absolute z-score at/above which a day is flagged.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of anomalies to return (most severe first).

parameters.name: apiId
parameters.description: Restrict analysis to a single API ID.
